assert json.loads((root / 'artifacts/ufuk-depth-transfer-20261003-v2/receipt.json').read_text())['status'] == 'pass'

weights = {

results = {}
for name, model in weights.items():
    directory = root / ('artifacts/ufuk-depth-' + name + '-train-20261003')
    assert not directory.exists()
    common = [sys.executable, '-m', 'harbichess.training.oracle_train', str(directory), '--dataset', str(root / 'artifacts/ufuk-balanced-data-20261003'), '--weights', str(model), '--qualification-reference', str(weights['control']), '--max-steps', '10000', '--interval', '250', '--patience', '1500', '--learning-rate', '5e-5', '--seed', '20261009', '--max-train-rows', '80000', '--max-validation-rows', '20000']
    started = time.perf_counter()
    receipts = []
    for phase in ('pause', 'resume'):
        remaining = 2400 - (time.perf_counter() - started) - 5
        assert remaining > 0
        cmd = common + ['--wall-seconds', str(min(600, remaining) if phase == 'pause' else remaining)]
        cmd += ['--stop-at', '250'] if phase == 'pause' else ['--resume', str(directory / 'checkpoints/step-000250')]
        print(json.dumps({'starting': name, 'phase': phase, 'remaining_wall': remaining}), flush=True)
        phase_started = time.perf_counter()
        completed = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=source, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(source / 'src')}, capture_output=True, text=True)
        receipt = {'command': cmd, 'cwd': str(source), 'PYTHONPATH': str(source / 'src'), 'returncode': completed.returncode, 'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - phase_started, 'stdout': completed.stdout, 'stderr': completed.stderr}
        receipts.append(receipt)
        if directory.exists():
            (directory / ('command-' + phase + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps({'finished': name, 'phase': phase, 'returncode': completed.returncode, 'wall_seconds': receipt['wall_seconds']}), flush=True)
        completed.check_returncode()
        result = json.loads(completed.stdout.splitlines()[-1])
        if phase == 'pause':
            assert result['reason'] == 'registered process boundary' and result['step'] == 250
    results[name] = {'total_wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started, 'result': result}
    (directory / 'phase-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(results[name], indent=2) + '\n')
    assert results[name]['total_wall_seconds'] < 2400

left = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-depth-control-train-20261003/checkpoints'
right = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-depth-deep-train-20261003/checkpoints'
common = sorted({p.name for p in left.iterdir()} & {p.name for p in right.iterdir()})

    b = torch.load(right / name / 'training.pt', weights_only=True)

import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

import chess
import mlx.core as mx
import numpy as np
import torch

from harbichess.backends.depth_transfer import deepen
from harbichess.backends.pairwise_network import HarbiChessPairwiseNetwork
from harbichess.backends.torch_network import load_weights, sha256
from harbichess.chess.actions import legal_action_indices
from harbichess.chess.encoding import BoardEncoder

root = pathlib.Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
source = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-all-train-20261003/checkpoints/step-009250/model.safetensors'
out = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-depth-transfer-20261003'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
torch.set_num_threads(1)
receipt = deepen(source, out / 'model.safetensors')
assert receipt['parameters'] == 91057
old, deep = load_weights(source), load_weights(out / 'model.safetensors')
assert sum(p.numel() for p in old.parameters()) == 72497
mlx = HarbiChessPairwiseNetwork.from_portable(out / 'model.safetensors')
boards = [chess.Board(f) for f in [chess.STARTING_FEN, 'r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1', 'r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R b KQkq - 0 1', '4k3/P7/8/8/8/8/7p/4K3 w - - 0 1', '4k3/P7/8/8/8/8/7p/4K3 b - - 0 1', '4k3/8/8/3pP3/8/8/8/4K3 w - d6 0 1']]
for opening in [['e2e4','c7c5','g1f3','d7d6'], ['d2d4','g8f6','c2c4','g7g6','b1c3']]:
    b = chess.Board()
    for uci in opening:
        b.push_uci(uci)
    boards.append(b)
cases = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for b in boards:
        encoded = BoardEncoder().encode_board(b)
        x = torch.tensor(encoded.values, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(1,8,8,104)
        a = torch.tensor([legal_action_indices(b)])
        full_old, full_deep = old(x), deep(x)
        mask_old, mask_deep = old.masked_policy_value(x,a), deep.masked_policy_value(x,a)
        full_mx = mlx(mx.array(x.numpy()))
        mask_mx = mlx.masked_policy_value(mx.array(x.numpy()),mx.array(a.numpy()))
        mx.eval(full_mx,mask_mx)
        for left,right in zip(full_old+mask_old,full_deep+mask_deep,strict=True):
            assert torch.equal(left,right)
        errors = []
        for left,right in zip(full_deep+mask_deep,full_mx+mask_mx,strict=True):
            np.testing.assert_allclose(left.numpy(),np.array(right),atol=2e-5,rtol=2e-5)
            errors.append(float(np.abs(left.numpy()-np.array(right)).max()))
        cases.append({'fen':b.fen(),'history':[m.uci() for m in b.move_stack],'torch_bitwise_equal':True,'mlx_errors':errors})

import torch

from harbichess.backends.torch_network import load_weights, sha256
from harbichess.chess.actions import legal_action_indices
from harbichess.chess.encoding import BoardEncoder

root = pathlib.Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
source = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-all-train-20261003/checkpoints/step-009250/model.safetensors'
out = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-depth-transfer-20261003-v2'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)

receipt = deepen(source, out / 'model.safetensors')
assert receipt['parameters'] == 91057
old, deep = load_weights(source), load_weights(out / 'model.safetensors')
assert sum(p.numel() for p in old.parameters()) == 72497
mlx = HarbiChessPairwiseNetwork.from_portable(out / 'model.safetensors')
boards = [chess.Board(f) for f in [chess.STARTING_FEN, 'r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1', 'r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R b KQkq - 0 1', '4k3/P7/8/8/8/8/7p/4K3 w - - 0 1', '4k3/P7/8/8/8/8/7p/4K3 b - - 0 1', '4k3/8/8/3pP3/8/8/8/4K3 w - d6 0 1']]
for opening in [['e2e4','c7c5','g1f3','d7d6'], ['d2d4','g8f6','c2c4','g7g6','b1c3']]:
    b = chess.Board()
    for uci in opening:
        b.push_uci(uci)
    boards.append(b)
cases = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for b in boards:
        encoded = BoardEncoder().encode_board(b)
        x = torch.tensor(encoded.values, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(1,8,8,104)
        a = torch.tensor([legal_action_indices(b)])
        full_old, full_deep = old(x), deep(x)
        mask_old, mask_deep = old.masked_policy_value(x,a), deep.masked_policy_value(x,a)
        full_mx = mlx(mx.array(x.numpy()))
        mask_mx = mlx.masked_policy_value(mx.array(x.numpy()),mx.array(a.numpy()))
        mx.eval(full_mx,mask_mx)
        for left,right in zip(full_old+mask_old,full_deep+mask_deep,strict=True):
            assert torch.equal(left,right)
        errors = []
        for left,right in zip(full_deep+mask_deep,full_mx+mask_mx,strict=True):
            np.testing.assert_allclose(left.numpy(),np.array(right),atol=2e-5,rtol=2e-5)
            errors.append(float(np.abs(left.numpy()-np.array(right)).max()))
        cases.append({'fen':b.fen(),'history':[m.uci() for m in b.move_stack],'torch_bitwise_equal':True,'mlx_errors':errors})
receipt.update(source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(), script_sha256=sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__)), cases=cases, status='pass', scope='Initial function equality only; not trained strength or full-resume transfer.')
(out / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':'pass','parameters':receipt['parameters'],'destination_sha256':receipt['destination_sha256'],'cases':len(cases)}))
